newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico names new head of bank fund Fobaproa.
newsitem.headline: Mexico names new head of bank fund Fobaproa.

text.p: Banco de Mexico on Wednesday named one of its directors, Javier Arrigunaga Gomez del Campo, to head the Bank Insurance Fund (Fobaproa) after its current head retires on April 1.
Arrigunaga will also head the Stock Market Securities Fund (Fameval), the central bank said in a statement.
He replaces Manuel Camacho Tellez who is due to retire after 40 years at Banco de Mexico. It said Arrigunaga had already worked closely with Fobaproa and Fameval.

Fobaproa has played a key role in supporting Mexican banks during the country's 1994-5 economic crisis, intervening troubled banks and acquiring past-due loans from healthier institutions who in exchange pledged to recapitalize their banking units.
Fobaproa's role as a guarantor of all deposits is due to be curbed from next year onwards, though officials say it will continue to safeguard Mexico's smallest depositors.
